records.title: PRED: Performance-oriented Random Early Detection for Consistently Stable Performance in Datacenters
records.abstract: PRED automatically adjusts random early detection parameters for changing datacenter traffic, targeting stable queueing and lower tail flow-completion time.

records.title: QiMeng-Xpiler: Transcompiling Tensor Programs for Deep Learning Systems with a Neural-Symbolic Approach
records.abstract: QiMeng-Xpiler combines large language models, symbolic repair, and autotuning to translate tensor programs across heterogeneous deep learning systems.

records.title: CounterSEVeillance: Performance-Counter Attacks on AMD SEV-SNP
records.abstract: CounterSEVeillance studies exposed performance counters in AMD SEV-SNP and demonstrates instruction-level side-channel recovery from protected virtual machines.

records.title: A Comprehensive Memory Safety Analysis of Bootloaders
records.abstract: A broad analysis examines memory-safety weaknesses in bootloader code and their consequences for system security.
